title: Health Charted Lab History
description: Timestamped lab results with context, interpretation, and recheck scheduling. Values are stored as native numerics so trend and threshold analysis reads numbers directly, never re-parses strings. Raw facts only — functional-optimal targets are interpretation and live in the reference/ layer.

context.description: Why these labs were ordered, fasting state, time of day

marker.description: Lab marker slug (kebab, e.g., 'ferritin'). The stable join key; the marker's display name and aliases live in the entity index (research/reference INDEX).

value_num.description: Numeric magnitude of the result — what trend/threshold math reads directly. Null for purely qualitative results.

value_text.description: Qualitative or operator-bearing result captured verbatim ('positive', 'trace', '<5', 'negative'). Used when the result is not a clean number, or to preserve the original alongside value_num.

standard_range.description: The lab-reported reference range — a FACT about this measurement (stays on the result). Functional/optimal targets are interpretation and live in reference/.

text.description: Non-numeric range expression when low/high don't apply (e.g., 'Negative').

assessment.description: Free-text interpretive note for this result.
